exposure: demographic factors (age, parity, history of ectopic pregnancy, smoking, contraceptive methods, reasons for consultation)
ultrasonographic findings (ectopic focus location, maximum diameter, presence of free fluid)
laboratory findings (preoperative hemoglobin, white blood cell counts)
outcome: Characteristics of patients requiring life-saving urgent surgery for ectopic pregnancy
Significant differences in demographic, ultrasonographic, and laboratory parameters between those who received prior MTX therapy and those who did not
cohort: 469 patients diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy who underwent life-saving urgent surgery at a Tersiyer Referral Hospital.
finding: Patients undergoing life-saving urgent surgery for ectopic pregnancy showed significant differences in age, parity, maximum diameter of the ectopic focus, preoperative hemoglobin and white blood cell levels, presence of free fluid, and contraceptive methods when comparing those with and without prior methotrexate therapy.
